items.comment: Could you share a small, shareable Parquet sample (or a short Python script that writes equivalent Parquet files) that still triggers this error when read with your query, together with the complete Python traceback? A minimal set of two Parquet files that disagree on the problematic column (missing vs present or differing type) is sufficient for reproducing and diagnosing the message.
items.label: needs reproducible example
items.rationale: The report describes read_parquet across multiple files and shows the concise ConversionException, but the private data and no example Parquet files prevent reproducing the mismatch (missing or type-different column) that triggers the error; a small shareable pair of Parquet files or a script that generates them is an essential dependency for first-pass triage.
